name: frontend-dependency-contract
body: Each of the eight apg language frontends (Go, Java, C++, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python, Markdown) must have its dependency contract stated in the durable spec: (a) its build-time dependencies, (b) its scan-time dependencies (what must exist on PATH when a user runs `apg scan`), and (c) the pinned engine whose version sets the language-version ceiling. The declaration is attached to that frontend's solution container and every code unit it names resolves in the branch graph, so "to scan X you need Y and Z" is answerable and traceable from the spec. Today only four of the eight frontends have containers (go/java/ts/py); rust/cpp/csharp/md have none, and no frontend container names its build-time deps, scan-time deps, or an engine pin.
